clue.text: Prima donna's new bed?

parts.note: a prima donna is a diva, the leading lady of an opera

explanation.surface: An opera star is asked whether her latest purchase is a fresh bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A divan is a low upholstered bed without a headboard or footboard.

clue.text: Risk claiming mobile home height is mammoth

indicators.note: claiming means taking hold of, so the word for risk wraps round the scrambled letters

parts.note: to risk money is to bet it

indicators.note: mobile means moving about, so the letters of home are rearranged

explanation.surface: Gambling on a mobile home of great height is a huge undertaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mammoth' reads as an adjective in the surface but is taken as a noun here, a giant.
explanation.definitionFit: A behemoth is an enormous creature or thing, so it serves as a noun sense of something gigantic.

clue.text: Home on time with a cold and temperature — otherwise unscathed

parts.note: being at home is being in
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Staying in with a cold and a fever, you'd otherwise come through unharmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left whole and undamaged has come through without injury, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Couple from Italy got together on the rebound

parts.note: I is the international vehicle registration letter for Italy

indicators.note: bouncing back means the word for got together is read backwards

parts.note: people who got together met

explanation.surface: An Italian pair met again after a break-up, a rebound romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, two people romantically linked are called an item, a pairing.

clue.text: Where the odds are you'll lose majority of cases by one negative vote

definitions.text: Where the odds are you'll lose

indicators.note: most of the word cases is kept, its final letters dropped

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a vote against is a no

explanation.surface: A lawyer is likely to lose most cases by a single vote against.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambling house is built so the bank has the edge; the punter is expected to come out behind there.

clue.text: Unorthodox scenarist with no right to enthral European film buffs

indicators.note: to enthral is to hold captive, so the scrambled letters surround another
unorthodox means unconventional, so the letters are rearranged
with no tells us a letter is taken away from scenarist

explanation.surface: An unconventional screenwriter captivates European movie fans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' removes R from SCENARIST, leaving SCENAIST; 'Unorthodox' rearranges it, and 'to enthral' wraps it round E.
explanation.definitionFit: Cineastes are enthusiasts of the cinema, people devoted to films.

clue.text: Bungle the Bear in winter

indicators.note: to bungle is to botch or mess up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Bungle the Bear, from the British children's TV show Rainbow, spends the cold season somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bungle' looks like the bear's name but signals the anagram of THE BEAR IN; 'winter' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To winter is to spend the cold months somewhere; animals that sleep through them do so dormant.

clue.text: Writer pens a point — elementary

indicators.note: pens means encloses, so the pen holds the other letters

parts.note: a Bic is a well-known brand of ballpoint pen
S is a compass point, south

explanation.surface: An author writes a straightforward argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Basic and elementary both mean fundamental and simple, at the first level.

clue.text: Go without wearing smalls in casual trousers

indicators.note: the two letters are worn around the other word, enclosing it

parts.note: small is abbreviated S, so two smalls give two S's
to go without something is to lack it

explanation.surface: Going without underwear under informal trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smalls' is British slang for underwear, but here it is two S's.
explanation.definitionFit: Slacks are loose informal trousers, a direct synonym.

clue.text: In harem a concubine's rejected — it's for taking pictures

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the letters are read in reverse
in tells us the letters sit inside the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: A concubine in a harem is turned away while someone takes photos.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera is the device used for photography, described here by its function.

clue.text: Holiday islands will be hit over disreputable bars

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word for hit is read backwards

parts.note: to lam is to beat or hit hard
a dive is a seedy drinking place

explanation.surface: Resort islands will be struck by trouble from sleazy bars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will be' is a link; 'over' reverses LAM, giving MAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The Maldives are an Indian Ocean island chain famous as a luxury holiday destination.

clue.text: Being tense during lesson

indicators.note: during places one piece within the other

parts.note: a moral is the lesson of a story
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: Someone is nervous through a class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being' is a noun, a living creature, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A mortal is a human, a creature subject to death, so a living being.

clue.text: This may be pivotal advice expressed by Cockney agony aunt?

indicators.note: a Cockney speaker of London's East End drops the H, so leave her is pronounced as a single word

parts.note: the advice is to dump the girlfriend, said as leave her

explanation.surface: A London advice columnist's guidance may be the crucial turning point.
explanation.walkthrough: An agony aunt is a newspaper advice columnist; Cockneys drop the H, so 'leave her' becomes 'leave 'er'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lever pivots on a fulcrum, so it is a thing that turns on a pivot.

clue.text: Select comfort initially over getting into fashionable shoe

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of comfort
getting into puts these letters inside the shoe
fashionable means made into a new style, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Pick comfort above all when buying a trendy shoe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashionable' rearranges SHOE into HOSE, and 'getting into' puts O inside it after the C.
explanation.definitionFit: To select is to pick, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: A pub landlord's calling — forgetting a name is acceptable

indicators.note: forgetting means leaving out, so a letter goes

parts.note: running an inn is a landlord's trade

explanation.surface: A publican's job means forgetting a name is fine.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in keeping is consistent with its setting, so appropriate or fitting.

clue.text: Little bird, missing female, reveals part of foot

indicators.note: missing means without, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: a finch is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A small bird without its mate shows part of its foot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foot' is the unit of length, not the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: There are twelve of this unit in a foot of length, so it is part of that measure.

clue.text: Exits not opening — they're stuck near the top

indicators.note: not opening says the first letter is dropped

parts.note: to exit is to leave, so exits gives leaves

explanation.surface: Doors that won't open are jammed high up.
explanation.definitionFit: The overhanging lower edges of a roof project near the top of a house's walls.

clue.text: Gave up, trapped by you once turning up offering fairness

indicators.note: trapped by means held inside another piece
in a down clue turning up reverses the word

parts.note: ye is the archaic form of you
to quit is to give up

explanation.surface: Someone quit after your old self came round, offering justice.
explanation.definitionFit: Equity is justice and impartiality, the quality of being even-handed.

clue.text: Fancy a fish first

indicators.note: first says the fish comes before the a

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish, a crossword regular

explanation.surface: Would you like a fish to start?
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy can be a notion or whim, a thought that occurs to one.

clue.text: Dire pint drunk without fear

indicators.note: drunk means intoxicated and so jumbled up

explanation.surface: A terrible pint is drunk boldly.
explanation.definitionFit: Intrepid means fearless and bold, matching the phrase.

clue.text: Disc jockey taking Ecstasy, a very upper-class thing we've seen before

indicators.note: taking means taking in, holding the other letters

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy
U denotes upper-class usage

explanation.surface: A club DJ on drugs is a familiar posh scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase names the feeling of having already witnessed something.

clue.text: Tunesmith, perhaps one with his head in the clouds?

definitions.meaning: a composer could whimsically be called a man of airs, a melody man

definitions.text: one with his head in the clouds?
definitions.meaning: a pilot of the air force flies among clouds

explanation.surface: A composer is a dreamer, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviator literally has his head in the clouds, while an air is a tune.

clue.text: Discount political argument with Republican having ousted Democrat

indicators.note: having ousted means one letter pushes another out

parts.note: a debate is a formal political argument

explanation.surface: A Republican drives a Democrat out of the debate.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebate is a partial refund or reduction in price.

clue.text: Signal to advance bishop — consider sacrificing rook

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: sacrificing means giving up, so a letter is lost

parts.note: to reckon is to consider
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A chess player advances a bishop and thinks about giving up a rook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advance' looks like a chess move but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To beckon is to gesture to someone to come nearer.

clue.text: Madagascan native using both hands to throttle bird

indicators.note: to throttle is to grip around the neck, so these letters enclose another

parts.note: L and R are left and right, both hands
the emu is a large flightless bird

explanation.surface: An islander strangles a bird with both hands.
explanation.definitionFit: This primate is found in the wild only on Madagascar.

clue.text: Work time — involuntary reaction is to become histrionic

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
an era is a period of time
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: On a work timetable, a nervous twitch becomes dramatic.
explanation.definitionFit: Operatic behaviour is overblown and theatrical, as on the stage.

clue.text: Roux, for example, essential to quiche? Fact!

indicators.note: essential to means at the core of, so the letters lie within the words

explanation.surface: A cook insists that a certain ingredient is vital to quiche.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roux' looks like a sauce base but is the surname of famous French chefs in Britain, such as Michel Roux.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roux family are renowned restaurant cooks, so a Roux is an example of a head cook.

clue.text: Primitive, we hear, as many boats should be?

indicators.note: we hear means the word is judged by its sound

parts.note: crude means primitive or unrefined

explanation.surface: Primitive boats are fitted out, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel with sailors aboard to operate it is staffed, as most boats need to be.

clue.text: Popular amateur marquetry

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
lay means non-professional, amateur

explanation.surface: Woodwork patterns enjoyed by hobbyists.
explanation.definitionFit: Marquetry is decorative work of pieces set into a wooden surface.

clue.text: Musical yours truly left? Repulsive!

parts.note: yours truly is a jokey way of saying me
odious means repulsive

explanation.surface: Someone who left a musical show calls it disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Musical' is an adjective meaning tuneful, not a stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuneful and pleasant to hear, the adjective sense of musical.
